shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v package-lock && cat package.json tsconfig.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null

for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)"

ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app 2>/dev/null | head; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50; curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; grep -rn -i 'metadata' docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md | head; grep -rn 'handleMethodNotAllowedResponse' server/route-modules/app-route/*.js server/route-modules/helpers/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rn -A8 'function handleMethodNotAllowedResponse' server/ 2>/dev/null | head -12; grep -rn -B3 -A10 'autoImplementMethods\|function autoImplementMethods' server/route-modules/app-route/helpers/auto-implement-methods.js | head -60

cd /workspace && cat > app/api/posts/types.ts <<'EOF'
export type ApiPost = {
  id: number
  title: string
  content: string
  createdAt?: string
  updatedAt?: string
}

export type PostInput = Partial<Pick<ApiPost, 'title' | 'content'>>
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='app/api/posts/route.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export type ApiPost = {
  id: number
  title: string
  content: string
  createdAt?: string
  updatedAt?: string
}

type CreatePostBody = Partial<Pick<ApiPost, 'title' | 'content'>>
""","""import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import type { ApiPost, PostInput } from './types'
""").replace("CreatePostBody","PostInput")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""import type { ApiPost } from '../route'

type UpdatePostBody = Partial<Pick<ApiPost, 'title' | 'content'>>
""","""import type { ApiPost, PostInput } from '../types'
""").replace("UpdatePostBody","PostInput")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
head -5 app/api/posts/route.ts app/api/posts/\[id\]/route.ts; grep -n PostInput app/api/posts -r

sed -i "s/font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;/font-family: var(--font-inter), sans-serif;/" styles/globals.css && grep -n font-family styles/globals.css && git rm -rq pages components/AppProvider.js && printf '.next/\nnext-env.d.ts\n' >> .gitignore && cat .gitignore && git status --short
ls pages 2>&1; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
B=http://localhost:3123
for p in / /blog /blog/3 /blog/42 /blog/99999 /nope; do printf '%-14s ' $p; curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w '%{http_code} ' $B$p; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/out.html | head -1; done
curl -s $B/ | grep -o 'Your user agent: [^<]*\|og:title" content="[^"]*"' 
curl -s $B/blog/3 | grep -o '<meta name="description" content="[^"]\{0,40\}\|Comments (<!-- -->[0-9]*'
echo; curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' $B/api/posts
curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"t","content":"c"}' $B/api/posts
curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' -X POST -d 'garbage' $B/api/posts
curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' $B/api/posts/7
curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' -X PUT -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"New"}' $B/api/posts/7
curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' -X DELETE $B/api/posts/7
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'PATCH %{http_code}\n' -X PATCH $B/api/posts/7
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X OPTIONS $B/api/posts/7 | grep -i '^allow'
grep -i error /tmp/next.log; pkill -f 'next start'

npx next build 2>&1 | grep -iE 'error|warn|✓ Compiled|Finished TypeScript' ; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4 for p in /blog/99999 /blog/7; do printf '%-14s ' $p; curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w '%{http_code} ' localhost:3123$p; grep -o '[^<]*\|404 - Page Not Found' /tmp/out.html | head -2 | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done cat /tmp/next.log | grep -i error; pkill -f 'next start' || true; git diff --stat tsconfig.json; git diff tsconfig.json
git checkout tsconfig.json && sed -i 's|".next/types/\*\*/\*.ts"\]|".next/types/**/*.ts", ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"]|' tsconfig.json && git diff tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC OK
